full_prompt_en: A square architectural photograph shows a low modern house beside a turquoise swimming pool in a lush, rocky garden. The building stretches across the middle of the frame as a sequence of flat white roof planes, slender supports, long glass walls, and a warm stone-faced core. At the left, a broad upper window sits above the lower shaded rooms, making the house appear both light and layered. Near the center-right, a sharply projecting roof canopy extends over a terrace and casts a clean angular shade on the glass beneath it. The pool fills most of the foreground, its clear blue-green water rippling over a bright floor and reflecting broken patches of sunlight. Large rounded rocks sit close to the lower edge and along the left pool border, linking the designed water to the surrounding terrain. Flowering shrubs with pink and red accents occupy the left bank, while dense green planting runs under the windows and around the stone walls. Tall trees frame the top corners, their dark leaf masses enclosing the open blue sky above the roof. Sunlight enters from the upper left, producing crisp highlights on the white eaves and lively caustic patterns in the water; the terrace and interior remain much darker. Transparent panes reflect the garden while revealing hints of shaded space beyond, adding depth to the horizontal façade. The palette balances white, honey stone, dark foliage, and glowing aqua. The view is slightly low and angled along the pool, so the water becomes a wide foreground path toward the building. The overall composition is airy but anchored in natural stone, with precise roof lines set against irregular greenery and shifting water light.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形建筑摄影描绘郁郁葱葱、多石花园中的低矮现代住宅与蓝绿色泳池。建筑横贯画面中部，由平坦白色屋面、细支撑、长玻璃墙和暖色石材核心组成层叠序列。左侧一排宽窗位于下层阴影空间之上，使房屋显得轻盈又有层次。中右位置，尖锐伸出的屋檐越过露台，在下方玻璃上投出干净的折角阴影。泳池占据前景大部，清透蓝绿水面在明亮池底上起伏，反射破碎阳光。大块圆石靠近下缘，也沿左侧池边排列，将设计过的水面与周围地形连接。粉红和红色花灌木占据左岸，浓绿植物沿窗下和石墙周围生长。高树框住上方两角，深色树叶围住屋顶上方开放的蓝天。阳光从左上进入，在白色檐口形成清晰亮边，在水中留下活泼的光纹；露台与室内则暗得多。透明玻璃既映出花园，也透出后方阴凉空间，使水平立面更有纵深。配色平衡白色、蜜色石面、深绿和发亮的水蓝。从泳池边略低的位置斜看，水面成为通向建筑的宽阔前景路径。整体构图通透，却由天然石头稳住，精确屋顶线条与不规则植物及流动水光相对。
style_prompt_en: The photography favors clean horizontal planes, slender vertical supports, and long transparent intervals, balanced by irregular textured masses. Bright white and warm mineral neutrals sit beside deep green and luminous aqua, keeping the geometry light without erasing natural material. Hard sun draws crisp angular shade under projecting edges, while reflected light flickers across smoother lower surfaces. Clear glass introduces layered reflections and darker interiors, so depth comes from transparency as well as recession. The viewpoint is low enough to give a broad reflective foreground weight, and organic framing softens the strict lines. The overall finish is calm, sunlit, and spatially open.
style_prompt_zh: 摄影强调干净的水平面、细竖向支撑和长条通透间隔，并以不规则粗糙体量平衡。明白色与暖矿物中性色并列深绿和发亮水蓝，让几何形保持轻盈，却不抹去天然材料。强日光在伸出边缘下画出清楚折角阴影，反射光在较平滑的低处表面闪动。透明表面带入层叠倒影与更暗的内部，使纵深既来自透视退远，也来自透过关系。视点足够低，让宽阔反光前景有重量，有机的框景则柔化严格线条。整体完成面平静、阳光充足且空间敞开。
theme_en: A modern house extending over a sunlit turquoise pool
theme_zh: 现代住宅延伸在阳光照亮的蓝绿色泳池旁
name: Richard Neutra
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
